outcome: Developers can now make small, human-supervised fixes without the full factory loop. The always-armed planning lock has a third exit: ./forge mode lite --by <name> --reason <why> opens a bounded, ledgered lite window; ./forge fix "<desc>" runs the fix with terra@high (write-enabled); ./forge mode done closes it only after one autoreview pass with no blockers over the committed base_sha..HEAD diff, within the file budget — and this works even post-ship (record_review accepts an open lite window). The full loop and the trace-only quickfix hatch are unchanged.
